Another approximately 3.25-3.75 s shows the game severely narrowed or obscured, with unknown pause state. Ordinary menu/window-management behavior is established, but exact deficit accounting remains unresolved.

The stronghold death and respawn are followed by End loading and a sustained pause/options/skin/video-settings sequence approximately 2.25-2.75 s long, compatible with the -2.45 s deficit. Death-screen time is not automatically added to GUI pause time.
A visible pause/settings visit lasts approximately 1.75-2.25 s, compatible with the 1.9167 s deficit.
Two visible pause/settings visits span combined transition bounds 1.5-2.5 s, compatible with the 1.833 s deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
